integrity: Complete constructive witnesses and exact integer-arithmetic rational-dual branch certificates are included, with a standard-library checker; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only n=2 through 7 over the binary alphabet, exactly one deletion, worst-case lists of size at most two; no all-length result, exhaustive optimizer classification, or efficient decoder. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed studies.
title: Exact binary two-list single-deletion optima through length seven
